newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eva Air raises ex-Paris to Far East rates.
newsitem.headline: Eva Air raises ex-Paris to Far East rates.

text.p: Taiwan airline, Eva Air said it increased cargo rates on its ex-Paris three times weekly Boeing 747-400 passenger service to Taipei, effective October 1.
"The increases vary from eight to 15 percent, the equivalent of 50 centimes to one france a kg depending on the destination," an Eva Air cargo spokesman told Reuters.
The biggest increases concerned Hong Kong, Australia and New Zealand, he said.
"Capacity has become tighter on the route while at the same time there has been a surge in demand making the market climate favourable to rates increases."
The B747-400 can handle between 15 to 20 tonnes of freight and the full route reads Paris-Vienna-Taipei.
Some of the cargo capacity is allocated to Eva Air's Vienna cargo station. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
